item.title: Re: Just an unordinary camera
item.content:encoded:
First of all, thank you for you feedback!

what actually happens with this?

I plan some test logs and also an incident report (more on that later)

Why are these test logs gonna be interesting to read? My concern is that you're just going to hint at there being interesting stuff here, which is a lot less interesting to read about than actually having interesting stuff; and I would strongly urge you to reconsider relying on heavy blackboxing here

Up for consideration. I will try to not use black boxes that much as I too think that it is boring but some stuff would need to be blacked out.

Beyond this, focusing on historical stuff feels like it's squandering the potential a little: it feels like this is a thing the foundation could use to predict future events and in turn, like something the foundation could be tricked by and accidentally cause something horrible to happen but??

I want to make an incident with a future picutre: A Class-D was on a photograph after a date where he should already have been terminated and so the foundation is thrown into disarray as they do not know what will happen if this Class-D dies (thoughts about a small scale CK-Class Restructuring Scenario).

item.title: Just an unordinary camera
item.content:encoded:
An old polariod camera with a changeable date. When a picture with a certain date is taken, the polaroid will display the area of the picture at that point in time. Works for the past and the future.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: An old polaroid camera with a changeable date. When a picture with a certain date is taken, the polaroid will display the area of the picture at that point in time. Works for the past and the future.

Central Narrative: The camera wa bought by a researcher, who is a hobby photographer, on a flea market. Intrigued by the turnable date of the camera he decided to play around with it only to find out that the picture changes depending on the date. Once he realised that the date and picture are connected he handed it in for further investigation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Since the containment and general overview of this SCP-object should be rather short. Alot of test logs of important historical events (e.g.: life of Jesus Christ) would be part of the article. Most of the importnat information would obviously be blacked out or would require O5 authorisation to access it.

Additional Notes: My mother tongue is not English so please excuse possible spelling mistakes.
